info.name: Tickbuddy
info.description:
Tickbuddy is a daily habit and event tracker.
Tickbuddy lets you keep track of what happens each day, such as your meditation, exercise, or how many cups of coffee you had. Your scripts and AI agents can also log automatically, for example to record nightly backups. Tickbuddy is flexible: use it for habits, chores, keeping an eye on automations, or anything else that matters to you. Over time, analyse patterns and statistics with the built-in analytics.
Your data is stored in Tickbuddy on your Nextcloud server. These companion apps can all read and write the same data: - Tickdroid, the Android app, available on F-Droid - Tickcli, a command-line client for your scripts and automations - TickLLMe, an MCP server that lets your AI agents log and read your entries
info.author: Martin Hammer
